lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is approximately uniform across the central ribcage area, becoming narrower and the lines becoming shorter toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the tenth vertical line segment (counting from anterior to posterior), occurring in the upper third of the torso mass where the line splits toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first two anterior lines and the final three posterior lines are truncated, failing to reach the ventral fringe. Line 11 is reduced to a singular elongated dash on the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the mid-lateral surface of the left hind limb, arranged in a tight semi-circular formation.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower section of the haunch align to form a near-horizontal geometric line segment approximately parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral-lyrate trajectory, extending upward and outward from the pedicles before curving medially at the distal end.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The horizontal pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the horizontal pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The light-colored ivory tips constitute approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron is visible across the bridge of the muzzle between the eyes. Two distinct white spots are located on the lower cheek. A white dorsal mane extends from the neck along the entire length of the spine.
